notes: Read the full 249-line numbered source before editing; every line was considered. Covered the ChartDatum interface (web L14-17: date:string/energy_kwh:number) verbatim and the two module helpers: shortDate (web L19-23 — new Date(iso), isNaN(getTime()) -> return iso, else `${getMonth()+1}/${getDate()}`) and isSameMonth (web L25-29 — getFullYear()===now.getFullYear() && getMonth()===now.getMonth()) — both ported byte-for-byte.

Covered the component signature + sites hook (web L31-45): {size} prop; useTranslation('dashboard') -> useNativeTranslation; useTeslaEnergySites() destructured as data:sites/isLoading:sitesLoading/isFetching:sitesFetching/isStale:sitesStale/isError:sitesIsError/dataUpdatedAt:sitesUpdatedAt/refetch:refetchSites; siteId = (sites ?? [])[0]?.energy_site_id — 1:1.

Covered the since derivation + history hook (web L47-63): since = useMemo(() => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate()-14); return d.toISOString().slice(0,10); }, []); useTeslaWCChargingHistory(siteId, since) destructured as data:history/isLoading:historyLoading/error:historyError/isFetching:historyFetching/isStale:historyStale/isError:historyIsError/dataUpdatedAt:historyUpdatedAt/refetch:refetchHistory — every name + the 14-day ISO yyyy-mm-dd window preserved verbatim.

Covered the combined freshness/state (web L65-72): isLoading = sitesLoading || (!!siteId && historyLoading); error = historyError; isFetching = sitesFetching || historyFetching; isStale = sitesStale || historyStale; isError = sitesIsError || historyIsError; updatedAt = Math.max(sitesUpdatedAt ?? 0, historyUpdatedAt ?? 0); hasSites = (sites ?? []).length > 0 — every expression and null-guard preserved.

Covered the chartData daily aggregation (web L74-86): const byDay = new Map<string,number>(); for each entry, day = (entry.timestamp ?? '').slice(0,10); skip empty day; byDay.set(day, (byDay.get(day) ?? 0) + (entry.energy_wh ?? 0)/1000); return Array.from(byDay.entries()).sort(([a],[b]) => a.localeCompare(b)).map(([day,kwh]) => ({date: shortDate(day), energy_kwh: kwh})) — the energy_wh->kWh /1000 conversion, per-day bucketing, and ascending-by-day sort all reproduced exactly. (The history is already SI Wh from the API; /1000 -> kWh for display only — no legacy unit-suffixed field is read or written, satisfying the SI cutover rules.)

Covered the current-month stats (web L88-99): monthEntries = entries.filter(e => isSameMonth(e.timestamp ?? '')); total = reduce((sum,e) => sum + (e.energy_wh ?? 0)/1000, 0); count = monthEntries.length; returned {monthTotalKwh: total, monthSessions: count, avgKwhPerSession: count>0 ? total/count : 0} — destructured as {monthTotalKwh, monthSessions, avgKwhPerSession}, byte-for-byte.

Covered the layout flags + refresh (web L101-108): isCompact = size.cols <= 1; isWide = size.cols >= 3; hasData = chartData.length > 0 && chartData.some(d => d.energy_kwh > 0); handleRefresh = () => { refetchSites(); if (siteId) refetchHistory(); } — preserved verbatim.

Covered the no-sites branch (web L110-132): when !hasSites && !isLoading, a title-less WidgetShell (loading=false, error=null, updatedAt=sitesUpdatedAt, isFetching=sitesFetching, isStale=sitesStale, isError=sitesIsError, onRefresh=()=>refetchSites()) wrapping a WidgetChartSummary (compact=isCompact, isEmpty, emptyMessage 'No Tesla Energy site linked', emptyIcon Plug glyph, stats=[], chart=null). i18n key widget.wallConnector.noSite preserved.

Covered the compact branch (web L134-166): when isCompact, a title-less WidgetShell (loading=isLoading, error=error?String(error):null, updatedAt, isFetching, isStale, isError, onRefresh=handleRefresh) wrapping a compact WidgetChartSummary (isEmpty=!hasData, emptyMessage 'No Wall Connector data', emptyIcon Plug, chart=null, stats = hasData ? [{This Month, fmtNumber(monthTotalKwh,1), kWh}, {Sessions, fmtInt(monthSessions)}] : []). The native WidgetChartSummary hides the chart slot when compact, matching the web {!compact && chart}. i18n keys monthTotal/sessions/noData preserved.

Covered the standard branch (web L168-248): stats:ChartSummaryStat[] = hasData ? [This Month -> fmtNumber(monthTotalKwh,1) kWh; Sessions -> fmtInt(monthSessions); Avg / Session -> fmtNumber(avgKwhPerSession,1) kWh] : []. tick = isWide ? axisTick : axisTickSm -> tickFontSize 11/10. Titled WidgetShell ('Wall Connector', neon-green Plug icon, loading/error/updatedAt/isFetching/isStale/isError/onRefresh=handleRefresh) wrapping WidgetChartSummary (stats + chart=<WallConnectorBarChart>, isEmpty=!hasData, same Plug empty icon + 'No Wall Connector data'). i18n keys monthTotal/sessions/avgPerSession/title/noData/energy preserved.

Recharts BarChart (web L208-244) -> native <WallConnectorBarChart> (no DOM/SVG in RN): a fixed-height (isWide?150:130) frame with a left Y-axis (3 ticks fmt(v,0) at domainMax / domainMax/2 / 0, mirroring web YAxis width={40} tickFormatter={(v)=>fmt(v,0)}), a plot with 0/50/100% grid lines (web chartGrid) and one View bar per ChartDatum (dataKey='energy_kwh'; height = max((energy_kwh/domainMax)*100, 3)% when energy_kwh>0, fill BAR_COLOR='#10b981' matching the web Bar fill, top corner radius 4 mirroring radius={[4,4,0,0]}), and an X-axis row of per-day labels (web XAxis dataKey='date'). domainMax = Math.max(maxEnergy, 1) approximates Recharts' auto [0,max] domain. The web charts `fmt` helper (fmtNumber, 1dp default) is inlined.

Browser-only / unported deps reduced and documented inline: react-i18next useTranslation('dashboard') -> useNativeTranslation t(key,fallback?) = (fallback ?? key) (none of this widget's keys interpolate); lucide Plug -> 🔌 glyph tinted neon-green (colors.success) for the title and muted (colors.textMuted) for the EmptyState; @/components/charts (Recharts + chartGrid/chartMargin/axisTick/axisTickSm/chartAnimation/fmt) -> the native WallConnectorBarChart above (the hover-only <Tooltip> with its contentStyle/cursor + formatter `${fmtNumber(value,1)} kWh` has no native analogue and is dropped, replaced by an accessibilityLabel summary; chartMargin/chartAnimation are Recharts-only presentation); useTeslaWCChargingHistory/useTeslaEnergySites -> already-ported web-parity hooks (request auto-prefixes /api/v1 so /tesla/energy-sites and /tesla/energy-sites/{id}/charging-history are reached verbatim); fmtNumber/fmtInt -> inlined native fmtNumber (en-US, min=max fraction digits) + fmtInt = fmtNumber(v,0); WidgetChartSummary + ChartSummaryStat -> native equivalents (stat grid + chart slot + EmptyState, ChartSummaryStat {label,value,unit?}); WidgetShell -> native shell reproducing the loading skeleton, error body, 1500ms pulse-on-update glow and the inline DataFreshness chip (fresh/fetching/stale/error glyph + relative time, tap-to-refresh, dot-only compact when title-less); ./types WidgetProps -> local WidgetSize{cols,rows}+WidgetProps.

Tailwind/DOM -> React Native: div/span/h-prefixed elements -> View/AppText; ResponsiveContainer width/height 100% -> fixed-height native frame; flex h-full flex-col -> View column; the stat row (grid grid-cols-2 / @sm flex) -> flexDirection row + flexWrap + statCell flexBasis 30% (3 stats in the standard layout); CSS vars text-[var(--text-primary|muted)] -> colors.textPrimary/textMuted; text-neon-green title intent -> colors.success; Plug h-3.5/h-5 sizing -> titleGlyph (13px) / emptyGlyph (20px). State names (sites/siteId/since/history/isLoading/error/isFetching/isStale/isError/updatedAt/hasSites/chartData/monthTotalKwh/monthSessions/avgKwhPerSession/isCompact/isWide/hasData/handleRefresh), the API paths (via useTeslaEnergySites + useTeslaWCChargingHistory), unit handling (energy_wh Wh -> kWh /1000 at the display boundary), and i18n intent are all preserved.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported. Imports limited to react, react-native (Pressable/StyleSheet/View/DimensionValue), the already-ported web-parity useEnergy hooks (useTeslaEnergySites/useTeslaWCChargingHistory), the native AppText, and the theme tokens (colors/spacing). StyleSheet keys + properties are alphabetically sorted for react-native/sort-styles. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
